question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (1)** i.e.** ‘discoveries’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Darwin planned to (1) **write **a book describing his (2) _____ He spent nearly twenty years (3) _____the matter for his book,
 
• Darwin planned to write a book where he wanted to describe something that he did in twenty years.
 
• In this context **‘discoveries’ (खोज)** is the most appropriate to fill in the blanks.** **
 
• **‘Discoveries’ **means findings of a long research and study. It says that he wanted to describe his twenty years of studies.
 
• Therefore, the word ‘**discoveries**’ contextually fits in the sentence.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is** Darwin planned to (1) ***write***__ a book describing his (2) ***__discoveries__***. He spent nearly twenty years (3) _____the matter for his book, which was to deal with every known fact concerning the problem of the species. Unluckily for Darwin, a naturalist named Wallace had been (4) _____over the same problems and had reached the same solution. He sent Darwin an essay which almost word for word repeated Darwin's own ideas. Yet Wallace, who was an (5) ____, had been working far away in the Malay Archipelago, whilst Darwin had not left England for several years. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Facts : (तथ्य)** - A thing that is known or proved to be true, not suitable in this context.
 
• **Articles : (लेख)** - A piece of writing included with others in a newspaper, magazine, or other publication, doesn’t fit the context.
 
• **Failures : (असफलता)** - Lack of success, not relevant here.
